original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: 5.2.4. Fluorescence titration Wild-type Nur77-LBD protein or mutant protein (1 μM in 3 mL phosphate buffer) was measured with Agilent Technologies Cary Eclipse Fluorescence Spectrophotometer, and the fluorescence spectra were obtained from 300 nm to 500 nm. Compounds (from 100 nM to 1 μM with an increment of 100 nM, from 1 μM to 2 μM with an increment of 250 nM, from 2 μM to 5 μM with an increment of 500 nM) were added to the protein. After incubation for 30 s at RT, the incubation buffer was measured with the spectrophotometer. Data were processed and fitted to obtain the binding affinities using Origin 2016.
original_paragraph.Results and Discussion: The dissociation constant of celastrol was evaluated as 0.32 μM [21], which is close to the Kd of 0.29 μM reported previously by the Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) binding analysis [12]. Thus, Celastrol was used as the positive control.
